description: This file manages storage and retrieval of access and refresh tokens in localStorage, providing utilities for token normalization, prefix stripping, and compatibility handling.

methods.name: normalizeStoredToken
methods.description: Normalizes stored token values by trimming whitespace and treating empty or specific invalid strings as null.

methods.name: stripBearerPrefix
methods.description: Removes 'Bearer ' prefix from tokens if present, returning the raw token string.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored access token, migrating from legacy key if necessary.

methods.name: setTokens
methods.description: Stores provided access and refresh tokens in localStorage after processing with stripBearerPrefix.

methods.name: clearTokens
methods.description: Removes all stored token items from localStorage.

methods.name: hasAnyToken
methods.description: Checks if there is any valid stored token (access or refresh).
